evidence.quote: promise one direct if it's going well maybe we'll do it later for two directs so let's start it with one direct referral for each one of you
every one that gonna join to my team from this video only not from other videos from this video I am going to change the link in my description to izreferra link

textual.context: Presented by the speaker as a promotional, time-limited team-building offer connected to joining MTI.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised referral benefit is directly linked to joining the speaker's team through a specified video referral arrangement, creating a reward-and-recruitment relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the referral benefit was delivered, whether joining required payment, or whether MTI or the offer was legitimate.

textual.observation: The speaker asks viewers to join through his referral link and send their name and referral link through comments or a Telegram channel so he can replace his referral URL with theirs until they receive a direct referral.

evidence.quote: everyone that's going to join me please send me in the comment or in my telegram channel that is published in my uh down down the description um send me your name and your raf link and i'm going to change my raf link to yours
join me for this video to my referral link for MTI and I'm going to change in the description the referral to you and so on and so on and so on to each one that going to join us

textual.context: This is described as a referral-chain arrangement; the source does not clarify what information is required beyond a name and referral link or whether any payment or transfer occurs.
textual.potential_relevance: Joining via a referral link and contacting the speaker through comments or Telegram are explicitly connected to receiving a direct-referral benefit and changing the destination link.
textual.limitations: The records do not show the actual links, the Telegram channel, any account or payment steps, or whether the promised referral was provided.

visual.observation: The dashboard visibly pairs "Direct Referrals" and left/right "Team" counts with "Binary Bonuses" and "Trading Bonuses" account balances.
visual.context: Unclear member-account dashboard context; the visible labels show referral/team metrics alongside bonus categories, but no explicit recruitment instruction is shown.
visual.potential_relevance: The pairing indicates a possible relationship between member recruitment structure and financial bonuses, which conditionally merits review of whether recruiting or maintaining team members is required to receive those rewards.
visual.limitations: These frames do not show the program terms, a request to recruit, payment or transfer instructions, payout conditions, or whether the displayed balances represent actual funds or completed outcomes.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker states that liking and subscribing are not conditions for receiving the referral publication, while identifying joining as the only condition.

evidence.quote: i'm not.. saying if you won't like my video or subscribe my chanel I don't give you... that's the minimum for get the publish of your referral , The only condition is to join me!

textual_context_notes.observation: The offer is repeatedly described as limited to the video or as a one-time offer.

evidence.quote: everyone that going to join my team... okay listen to me right leg team so every one that gonna join to my team from this video only not from other videos

visual_context_notes.observation: An "Official Announcement" panel labeled "Important Security Update" states that the member count grew by almost 2000 and describes trading as MTI's primary focus, with a stated aim for Bitcoin to grow over time gradually.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the creator promotes joining Mirror Trading International through a referral link in exchange for promised direct referrals and team-building benefits. It directs viewers to join through the description link and send their name and referral link so the creator can cycle the URL among recruits, creating a recruitment-based benefit rather than presenting neutral analysis or reporting. The video therefore contains an observable solicitation involving enrollment in a trading/referral scheme and consequential participation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The observed mechanism is recruitment into a team and referral structure. The speaker asks viewers to join his MTI team through his referral link and links that participation to receiving a direct referral.
